TC_SMOKE_001.description: Verify that the Dashboard loads the KPI cards and the document list.
TC_SMOKE_001.preconditions: User signed in as Super Admin
TC_SMOKE_001.steps:
1. Open the Dashboard.
2. Observe the KPI cards and the document list.
TC_SMOKE_001.expectedResult: Total Documents, Pending Review, Processing and Reviewed show numbers, the document list has rows, and no page or server error occurs.

TC_SMOKE_002.description: Verify that clicking a Dashboard card lists the documents of that status.
TC_SMOKE_002.preconditions: User signed in as Super Admin
TC_SMOKE_002.expectedResult: The card is selected and the list shows 'Pending Review' with the card's number of documents.

TC_SMOKE_013.description: Verify that a Purchase Order PDF can be uploaded.
TC_SMOKE_013.preconditions: User signed in as Super Admin
TC_SMOKE_013.steps:
1. Click Upload New File on the Dashboard.
2. Select Purchase Order.
3. Choose a PO PDF.
4. Click Upload and Process.
TC_SMOKE_013.expectedResult: The Dashboard opens and "File uploaded successfully" is displayed for the file.

TC_SMOKE_014.description: Verify that the uploaded document finishes extraction.
TC_SMOKE_014.steps:
1. Open Documents.
2. Search the uploaded file.
TC_SMOKE_014.expectedResult: The document is listed with the status Extracted and a Review button.

TC_SMOKE_015.description: Verify that the uploaded document can be reviewed and completed.
TC_SMOKE_015.steps:
1. Click Review.
2. Check the PDF and the extracted fields.
3. Click Complete.
TC_SMOKE_015.expectedResult: The Review page shows the file, the PDF and the extracted fields; "Document review completed and saved!" is displayed and the status is Reviewed.

TC_SMOKE_018.description: Verify that an emailed PO is processed and the Sales Order is created in the ERP.
TC_SMOKE_018.preconditions: The sender is a user of the Riverstone organization
TC_SMOKE_018.steps:
1. Email a PO PDF with the subject 'Purchase Order <token>'.
2. Check the reply email.
TC_SMOKE_018.testData:
Sender: riverstreamautomation@gmail.com (riverstonetech user)
To: riverstream.qa@riverstonetech.in
Generated PO PDF
TC_SMOKE_018.expectedResult: The reply "ERP Sales Order Processing Summary" shows the file, "Sales Order created successfully in ERP" and the Sales Order Number (SAL-ORD-...).

TC_SMOKE_019.description: Verify that an emailed Quote is processed and the Quotation is created in the ERP.
TC_SMOKE_019.preconditions: The sender is a user of the Riverstone organization
TC_SMOKE_019.steps:
1. Email a quotation PDF with the subject 'Quotation/Estimation <token>'.
2. Check the reply email.
TC_SMOKE_019.testData:
Sender: riverstreamautomation@gmail.com (riverstonetech user)
To: riverstream.qa@riverstonetech.in
Generated quotation PDF
TC_SMOKE_019.expectedResult: The reply "ERP Quotation Processing Summary" shows the file (the Quotation is created in the ERP).

TC_SMOKE_020.description: Verify that Review in Stream in the PO reply opens the review page.
TC_SMOKE_020.steps: 1. Click Review in Stream in the PO reply.
TC_SMOKE_020.expectedResult: The review page of the emailed PO opens with the PDF and the extracted fields.

TC_SMOKE_021.description: Verify the "No Attachment Found" reply for an email without attachment.
TC_SMOKE_021.preconditions: The sender is a user of the Riverstone organization
TC_SMOKE_021.steps:
1. Send an email without attachment.
2. Check the reply email.
TC_SMOKE_021.expectedResult: The reply "No Attachment Found" says the email did not include any supported attachments.

TC_SMOKE_022.description: Verify the "Request Type Doesn't Match Attachment" reply when the subject says Quote and the attachment is a PO.
TC_SMOKE_022.preconditions: The sender is a user of the Riverstone organization
TC_SMOKE_022.steps:
1. Email a PO PDF with the subject 'Quotation/Estimation request <token>'.
2. Check the reply email.
TC_SMOKE_022.testData:
Sender: riverstreamautomation@gmail.com (riverstonetech user)
To: riverstream.qa@riverstonetech.in
Generated PO PDF
TC_SMOKE_022.expectedResult: The reply "Request Type Doesn't Match Attachment" shows: Your email indicated Quotation/Estimation, your attachment looks like Purchase Order; no Sales Order is created.

TC_SMOKE_023.description: Verify the "Attachment Couldn't Be Read" reply for an unreadable attachment.
TC_SMOKE_023.preconditions: The sender is a user of the Riverstone organization
TC_SMOKE_023.steps:
1. Email an image saved as .pdf.
2. Check the reply email.
TC_SMOKE_023.testData:
Sender: riverstreamautomation@gmail.com (riverstonetech user)
To: riverstream.qa@riverstonetech.in
Image saved with a .pdf extension
TC_SMOKE_023.expectedResult: The reply "Attachment Couldn't Be Read" names the file; no Sales Order is created.
